heading: Tuesday, July 7, 2026
topLine: Meta launches Muse Image and previews Muse Video.

items.headline: Meta launches Muse Image and previews Muse Video
items.summary: Muse Image is Meta Superintelligence Labs' first image generation and editing model, which can use search and refine its own drafts; it launched in Meta AI, Instagram Stories (US) and WhatsApp (limited countries). Meta reports it ranked No. 2 on Arena's text-to-image leaderboard and previewed Muse Video, a video model with native audio still in development.
